tools.name: get_game_context

tools.name: get_game_settings
tools.description: Read supported global game options and the current colony's storyteller/difficulty, with available choices. Works without a colony for global options.

tools.name: set_game_settings
tools.description: Change supported global options or the current colony's storyteller/difficulty preset. Only supplied fields change. Global options are saved; colony settings persist with the normal game save. Changing only the storyteller preserves custom difficulty. Requires Allow changes.

storytellerDefName.description: Selectable StorytellerDef defName from get_game_settings. Requires a loaded game.

difficultyDefName.description: Non-custom DifficultyDef defName from get_game_settings. Replaces the current difficulty with that preset; requires a loaded game.

automaticPauseMode.description: Which events automatically pause the game.

autosaveIntervalDays.description: Autosave interval in game days, using the normal game options.

tools.description: Set one Assign-style pawn setting: schedule, policy, medical care, self-tend, hostility response, allowed area, carried medicine, or prisoner interaction.

mapId.description: Optional RimWorld map id. Defaults to current map.

assignments.description: Required when assignmentKind is schedule. Ranges are half-open, non-overlapping, and use hours 0 through 24.

assignmentDefName.description: TimeAssignmentDef defName, such as Anything, Work, Joy, Sleep, or Meditate.

policyKind.description: Required when assignmentKind is policy. Policy column to set.

policyId.description: Required when assignmentKind is policy. Policy id returned by list_pawns include=["assignmentOptions"].

care.description: Required when assignmentKind is medicalCare. Medical care category.

enabled.description: Required when assignmentKind is selfTend. Whether self-tend should be enabled.

mode.description: Required when assignmentKind is hostilityResponse. Hostility response mode.

areaId.description: Required when assignmentKind is allowedArea. Area id from assignmentOptions, or unrestricted to clear it.

count.description: Required when assignmentKind is carryMedicine. Medicine count to carry.

medicineDefName.description: Optional when assignmentKind is carryMedicine. Medicine ThingDef defName from assignmentOptions; omit to keep the current medicine.

interactionModeDefName.description: Required when assignmentKind is prisonerInteraction. PrisonerInteractionModeDef defName, such as AttemptRecruit, ReduceResistance, Convert, or Release.
